description: Partially updates the naming rules (delimiter, case, unknown-word handling, self-reference role prefix). Existing physical names are not regenerated retroactively (noted in warnings) — set the rules before modelling.

selfReferencePrefix.description: Role prefix for self-referencing FK names, keeping them distinct from the PK (e.g. 'Parent' → 'Parent Post Number' → PRNT_POST_NO). It is resolved through the word list like any other word, so register it first. Defaults to 'Parent' when unset or blank; projects created before that default keep the prefix they were built with.

source.description: Target ERD — exactly one of a local file ({file}) or a server ERD ({erdId})

name: update_naming_rules
